descriptions.luba-3-awd-5000: The flagship of the LUBA family. All-wheel drive, RTK + Vision navigation, and enough capacity for estate-sized lawns — it mows while you live.
descriptions.luba-3-awd-3000: All the flagship technology, sized for large family gardens. Perfect stripes, no boundary wires, no effort.
descriptions.luba-3-awd-1500: Serious slope-climbing power for mid-size lawns with tricky terrain, tight passages, and steep banks.
descriptions.luba-mini-awd-1500: The compact AWD mower that handles narrow gates and dense landscaping without giving up climbing ability.
descriptions.luba-mini-awd-800: Everything a city garden needs: quiet, precise, wire-free mowing that fits smaller spaces and budgets.
descriptions.spino-e1-pool: Drop it in and forget it. The Spino E1 scrubs floor, walls, and waterline, then parks itself at the edge for easy retrieval.
